Meta.title: Cedophe ZOHOUN | Network & Security Engineer
Meta.description: Portfolio of Cedophe ZOHOUN, a bilingual network and security engineer with working AWS and Azure knowledge. Anonymized case studies, certifications, and contact.

Home.positioning: I design, secure, and operate networks across on-premises and cloud. I document the work so it can be run, audited, and handed over.
Home.selectedLabsIntro: Seven anonymized case studies from professional practice. Each opens with context, approach, stack, and constraints.
Home.certificationsIntro: Four completed certifications, each with its issuer and current status.
Home.experienceIntro: Two roles, one through-line: networks, security, and the cloud that extends them.
Home.approachBody: I start from how the system actually runs, document every change, and leave behind material someone can use: policy, procedure, and inventory. Security is not a layer added at the end; it is part of the design.
Home.contactTitle: Bring a network that has to hold.
Home.contactBody: If you are hiring for network, security, or cloud work, or need someone who can document the estate, start here.
Home.trainingBody: Delivered CCNA, CCNP ENCOR, and AWS Cloud Practitioner training to 50+ learners.
Home.bilingualBody: The portfolio and CV exist in French and English. Switching language keeps the current page.
